review_scope: Literal-question/key scope validation only; independent of any parent scope decisions.
decisions: Raw required_facts labels do not by themselves determine asked scope. Each exact raw record appears once and is classified against the literal question.

Scenario givens are not independent demanded calculations. Q008 requires defense’s win, Q010 requires permission to mix reward types, Q101 requires completion before power loss and Q141 requires compensation before rewards; supplied numbers or explanatory recitals are not independently required.

Explicitly requested numeric results remain required in Q024, Q045, Q062, Q064 and Q065. A written arithmetic transcript is not required where an equivalent complete procedure and asked result suffice.
Required role, optionality, phase, timing, cost, exception, source, destination and outcome clauses remain required when literally asked.

The expressly asked conditional cases, including Q059 low-total-wins, Q095 Anti-Matter prevention and Q143 self-designating special, remain required without adjudicating source accuracy or core reachability.
Unasked examples and supplemental rules have their own background atoms; mixed records retain their required portions. Entire background records have no required clause links.
Source strings are preserved as question-level locators; assigning their IDs does not certify primary support.
Q086 is absent from the supplied bank; the 164 supplied IDs run Q001–Q165 excluding Q086, and no missing question is invented.
